name: プラダー・ウィリー症候群

summary.text: A rare genetic, neurodevelopmental syndrome characterized by hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction with severe hypotonia and feeding deficits during the neonatal period followed by an excessive weight gain period with hyperphagia with a risk of severe obesity during childhood and adulthood, learning difficulties, deficits of social skills and behavioral problems or severe psychiatric problems.

symptoms.text: feeding deficits during the neonatal period
behavioral problems or severe psychiatric problems
